Remaining steps, in order, from the study folder: (1) wait for 'done in' in the three run_*_minute.nohup logs; (2) python posthoc_minskip.py (the declared post-hoc min-skip-10% nested-CV variant on all 12 study x tf x label tables; ~10 min); (3) python write_findings.py (composes FINDINGS.md = narrative + TABLES.md, and findings.json, from the CSV/JSON outputs; a dry run on the 5-minute outputs already succeeded: ledger 755 lines, 0 unparseable, 0 missing vectors). The FINDINGS.md / findings.json currently in the folder are from that dry run and cover the 5-minute tables plus the 1-minute descriptive, bar-aftermath and episode tables only; the 1-minute grid/nested/family sections and the post-hoc rows will fill in once steps 1-3 run. Also note: the harness kept floors do not bound the skipped set, so the pre-registered selection criterion is dominated by tiny-skip cells on every table; reported as a caveat and addressed by the post-hoc variant, not by changing the pre-registered rule.
